capabilities: View task cards filtered by day, week, month, or overdue status
Edit cards inline with dates, repeats, assignees, comments and photos
Send cards or sections to a Canvas and copy card IDs for linking
Archive sections to a linked Archive note and move them back
Convert older card syntax to the current format with a backup
extras: Under active development with frequent changes; the README warns users to back up data before use. States the project is built entirely by AI agents using Claude and the developer has limited programming experience. Donations accepted via Ko-fi.
intentEvidence: It grew from there into a board built around dates and comments.
problem: Kanban boards in Obsidian organize cards by stage rather than by time, and task dates, repeats and comments usually require separate plugins or non-plain-text storage.

relations.evidence: Card Table was inspired by the table view of the Kanban plugin
Card Table writes due, start and repeat the way the Tasks plugin reads them
every [key:: value] field is visible to Dataview queries

summary: A Kanban-style task board where dated cards with assignees, pins, comments and repeats stay as plain text in the note.
